name: Suzuki DR650
engine: 644 cc air/oil-cooled SOHC single, one carb
intro: A tough, simple dual-sport single. A few known weak spots, all cheap to fix.

add.title: Check the countershaft nut and seal
add.instructions: With the clutch cover off, check the countershaft nut torque (72.5 ft-lb, left-hand thread). Look for oil at the countershaft seal and fit the seal retainer, Suzuki part 24751-32E00.
add.reason: A loose nut damages the key, and a leaking seal sprays oil on the chain.

add.title: Check the upper chain roller mount
add.instructions: Inspect the frame where the upper chain roller bolts on. Look for cracks around the hole.
add.reason: The roller mount can crack the frame.

G: The stock carb runs lean. Popping on decel or a rough idle at altitude often goes away with a jet or needle change.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.
